The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1c4d90b5ed4de2ef), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 6-7. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: For each integer D ≥ 2 there is an integer n0(D) with the following property. Let Y be the vertex set of a countable connected simple graph of degree at most D, and let a countable group H act by graph automorphisms, freely on vertices. Suppose n ≥ n0(D) and K is an H-invariant subcomplex of the full simplex on Y such that: 6 (i) K is generated by its n-simplices and has finitely many H-orbits of simplices; (ii) the vertices of each n-simplex span a connected subgraph of Y . Then every H-invariant cocycle ψ : En → C evaluates to zero on the image in (En)H of every cycle in Cn(K)H.
